ELK.js 0.11.0, bundled browser distribution.

- Upstream: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
- File: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/elkjs@0.11.0/lib/elk.bundled.js
- License: EPL-2.0, included in ELK-LICENSE.md (upstream also offers GPL-3.0).

Served locally so the companion needs no CDN, npm, or build step at runtime.
The upstream bundle is unmodified.
